about: What may not appear in the repository's files. PublicContentGuardTests reads this file and checks every file under the
roots below. Each rule is a .NET regular expression run on each file and on its path; a hit fails the test with its
file and line. A rule's allowValue is a regular expression for the matched texts (its 'v' group when it has one) that
are fine anywhere; allowAt lists, per file, a regular expression the whole match must match to be fine there. The test
also applies the rules of an optional local rules file of the same schema when one is present.

rules.why: A Windows profile path names a user. '..' and '.' are path-traversal test inputs (C:\Users\..\ProgramData resolves to ProgramData) and the rest are the generic profile names Windows itself has or a documented placeholder, none of them a person.
An e-mail address. Allowed: the commit attribution address and the reserved example domains (RFC 2606/6761: example.com/.net/.org, .example, .invalid, .test, .localhost).
